analysis.hypothesis: The compile error is caused by calling __device__ function ceil_div from __host__ launcher functions. This happens because ceil_div lacks __host__ qualifier, so it is only available on device. The minimal fix is to add __host__ __device__ qualifiers to ceil_div so it can be used in both host and device code.
